body: Core fix: contextFor() now returns omitted counters, a truncated flag and the budget (previously computed but dropped), with a final guard that keeps the packet within budget. UI: collapsible 'Agent context packet' (loaded on open) with a per-part included/omitted table, an explicit incomplete notice naming missing counts and shortened description, pointer to the full sections above and --budget, raw JSON only as a technical detail. Verified in Chromium (60 comments, 41 omitted at 8 KB).
